seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
從腹股溝處進入體腔後，聯屬脾部(包括胰)的腹膜間隙，聯絡胃部位的腹膜間隙。向上穿過膈肌食管裂孔沿食管周圍的胸膜間隙向上到達舌根部，布散舌下的黏膜間隙。
腹腔內支脈循行路線：從胃部經脈分出，向上穿過膈肌主動脈裂孔，隨主動脈根部胸膜進入心包。

【體表循行縫隙描述】
(足部) 足太陰脾經起於足大趾內側指甲角，過第一跖趾關節處，沿第一跖骨與足底內側肌群的縫隙處，至內踝前下與足舟骨的縫隙。需要注意的是，足太陰經在內踝部的循行路徑，從古典文獻和臨床實踐結合來看，還不能確定。
(小腿部) 向上行於脛骨後肌與趾長屈肌之間的縫隙至膝關節髌韌帶與外側副韌帶之間。
(大腿部) 上行於股直肌與股內側肌之間的縫隙，行至腹股溝處進入體腔循行。
(胸腹部) 循行於腹部腹內外斜肌和腹橫肌之間(前正中線旁開4寸)和胸部前鋸肌與肋間肌之間的縫隙(前正中線旁開6寸),至第二肋間隙周榮穴後折向腋下，絡於大包穴(脾之大絡，出淵腋下3寸，布胸脅)。
qihua_zh:
【足太陰經氣化功能】
足太陰經內屬於脾，外行於隱白至大包的縫隙中，通過足太陰經別加強本經對脾和胃的聯繫。脾為後天之本，一切營養來源、加工、分布、代謝和全身各處的供應都跟脾有直接關係，這是人體生存不可缺失的。《素問·靈蘭秘典論》曰：「脾胃者，倉廩之官，五味出焉。」《素問·宣明五氣》曰：「脾藏意。」說明了足太陰經主營養吸收，對保證人的正常精神意識和記憶力也有重要的作用。

【古籍中「脾與胰」之解剖考證】
需要說明的是，中醫說的脾比西醫說的脾功能要重要得多。在中醫文獻中，對於脾的解剖描述很多：
• 《醫學入門·臟腑》稱其「扁似馬蹄」（指脾臟）。
• 《醫貫》稱其「色如馬肝紫赤，其形如刀鐮」。
• 《醫綱總樞》稱其「形如犬舌，狀如雞冠，生於胃下，橫貼胃底，與第一腰骨相齊、頭大向右至小腸，尾尖向左連脾肉邊，中有一管斜入腸、名曰瓏管」（指胰臟與胰管）。
其中扁似馬蹄是指脾而言，形如刀鐮犬舌雞冠則是指胰。從古籍記載脾的位置、形態看，中醫藏象學說中的脾作為解剖學單位，應該包括現代解剖學中的脾和胰。但其生理功能還包含了脾胃、肝膽、大小腸等綜合的生理功能。

【影響足太陰經氣化的因素】
主要有兩方面：一是脾的運化功能發生障礙，消瘦易倦、記憶力減退、營養不良、慢性出血等；二是足太陰經在經絡循行路徑上的經氣運行出現問題，例如股膝內腫厥、足大趾不用等，都會出現足太陰經絡異常，集中在陰陵泉、地機、三陰交、公孫、太白等處出現結絡或者結塊。
足太陰經氣化的具體功能：主運化、行津液，主生血與統血，主升清、主肌肉和四肢、主藏意。

pathway_zh: 起於大趾末端內側（隱白），沿大趾內側赤白肉際，過第一跖趾關節，上內踝前緣，沿小腿內側正中上行（交出足厥陰肝經之後），過膝股內向前緣，入腹，屬脾，絡胃。上膈，挾咽，連舌本，散舌下。分支從胃別上膈，注心中（接手少陰心經）。
pathway_en: Originates at the medial tip of the big toe (SP 1 Yinbai), ascends along the red-and-white border of the foot, passes in front of the medial malleolus, ascends the medial calf (crossing behind the Liver Channel at 8 cun above malleolus), continues up the medial thigh into the abdomen to enter the Spleen and connect with the Stomach. Passes through the diaphragm, ascends along the esophagus, and spreads under the tongue. A branch ascends from the Stomach through the diaphragm to enter the Heart (connecting with HT 1).
indications_zh: 脾胃消化病症：腹脹、腹瀉、便秘、水腫、黃疸、胃痛、嘔吐。
婦科與生殖病症：月經不調、痛經、崩漏、帶下、不孕、小便不利。
血證與氣虛：慢性出血、貧血、疲乏無力、身重肢倦。
循行部位病症：膝股內側痛、腳氣、下肢水腫或麻木。
indications_en: Digestive disorders: Abdominal distension, diarrhea, constipation, edema, jaundice, gastralgia, vomiting.
Gynecological & reproductive disorders: Irregular menstruation, dysmenorrhea, metrorrhagia, leukorrhea, infertility, dysuria.
Blood & Qi deficiency disorders: Chronic bleeding, anemia, chronic fatigue, heavy sensation of body/limbs.
Pathway disorders: Medial thigh/knee pain, beriberi, lower limb edema/numbness.
applications_zh: 主司健脾益氣，運化水濕，統血調經，清熱利濕。
三陰交（足三陰經交會穴/婦科要穴）、太白（原穴/健脾第一穴）、陰陵泉（合穴/利濕要穴）、血海（活血養血要穴）、公孫（絡穴/通沖脈/調理胃心胸）。
與足陽明胃經相表裡，脾主運化與統血，善治消化不良、婦科月經病與全身水腫。
applications_en: Governs fortifying the Spleen, transforming dampness, controlling blood, regulating menses, and clearing damp-heat.

Core points: SP 6 Sanyinjiao (Three Yin Meeting / major gynecological point), SP 3 Taibai (Yuan-Source / primary Spleen tonic), SP 9 Yinlingquan (He-Sea / essential damp-draining point), SP 10 Xuehai (Blood Sea / regulates and cools blood), SP 4 Gongsun (Luo-Connecting / Confluent to Chong Vessel).

paired_channel: SI (Small Intestine Channel / 手太陽小腸經)
pathway_zh: 起於心中，出屬心系，下膈，絡小腸。分支從心系向上挾咽，連目系。直行支從心系出腋下（極泉），沿上臂內側後緣下行，至肘內側（少海），沿前臂內側後緣，抵掌後銳骨端（神門），入掌內（少府），出小指橈側端（少衝，接手太陽小腸經）。
pathway_en: Originates in the Heart, emerges to connect with the Heart system, descends through the diaphragm to connect with the Small Intestine. A branch ascends from the Heart system along the esophagus to connect with the eye system. The straight branch ascends from the Heart system to the axilla (HT 1 Jiquan), descends along the posterior aspect of the medial arm to the elbow (HT 3 Shaohai), continues down the posterior medial forearm to the pisiform bone (HT 7 Shenmen), enters the palm (HT 8 Shaofu), and terminates at the radial tip of the little finger (HT 9 Shaochong, connecting with SI 1).
indications_zh: 心血管與胸部病症：心悸、心痛、胸悶、氣短、心律不齊。
神志與睡眠病症：失眠、多夢、健忘、焦慮、神昏、癲狂、言語障礙。
循行部位病症：腋下痛、肘臂內側後緣痛、手心熱。
indications_en: Cardiovascular & chest disorders: Palpitations, cardiac pain, chest tightness, shortness of breath, arrhythmia.
Mental & Shen disorders: Insomnia, vivid dreaming, amnesia, anxiety, coma, psychosis, speech impairment / aphasia.
Pathway disorders: Axillary pain, pain along the posterior medial aspect of the arm/forearm, heat in palms.
applications_zh: 主司清心瀉火，安神定志，通經活絡，調理心機能。
神門（原穴/安神第一要穴）、通里（絡穴/言語失語要穴）、少海（合穴/清心熱）、少衝（井穴/急救甦厥）。
applications_en: Governs clearing Heart fire, calming the Shen (spirit), unblocking channels, and regulating cardiac function.

Core points: HT 7 Shenmen (Yuan-Source / primary point for insomnia and anxiety), HT 5 Tongli (Luo-Connecting / speech disorders), HT 3 Shaohai (He-Sea / clears Heart heat), HT 9 Shaochong (Jing-Well / resuscitation).
seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
起於心中，分支下穿膈肌屬心絡小腸；分支上行夾咽連目系；主幹上肺出腋下。

【體表循行縫隙描述】
上臂部行於肱二頭肌內側溝縫隙中；前臂部行於尺側腕屈肌腱與指淺屈肌腱之間的縫隙；手掌部沿第四、五掌骨間行至小指橈側指甲角。
qihua_zh:
【手少陰經氣化功能】
手少陰心經內屬於心，外行於極泉至少衝。《素問·靈蘭秘典論》曰：「心者，君主之官也，神明出焉。」心主血脈，又主藏神。

【心與小腸表裡關係】
心與小腸相表裡，心火旺盛可下移小腸，出現小便短赤、灼熱痛感；小腸熱亦可上炎於心，見口舌生瘡、心煩失眠。
pathomechanism_zh:
【主要病候】
心痛，心悸，失眠，黃疸，脅痛，臑臂內側後緣痛，掌中熱痛，嗌乾，渴而欲飲。

【《靈樞·經脈》是動病與所生病原文】
是動病：嗌乾，心痛，渴而欲飲，是為臂厥。
所生病：目黃，脅痛，臑臂內後廉痛厥，掌中熱痛。

【常見經絡異常按診切診 3 段判讀】
1. 神門至通里段：若按壓極度酸痛或有深層細小結節，提示心氣不足、心血虛（心悸、失眠、健忘）。
2. 少海段：肘內側壓痛或發硬提示心火亢盛或心脈瘀阻（胸悶、心前區痛）。
3. 極泉至青靈段：若有明顯腫塊或拉扯疼痛，提示心胸氣滯血瘀或腋下淋巴結腫大。
pathomechanism_en:
【Heart Channel Pathomechanism (Shi Dong & Suo Sheng)】
• Shi Dong Pathologies: Dryness of throat, cardiac pain, thirst with desire to drink, arm Bi-syndrome (臂厥).
• Suo Sheng Pathologies: Yellow eyes, hypochondriac pain, pain and coldness along the medial posterior aspect of arm and forearm, heat and pain in palms.
preservation_zh:
【心經日常保養與導引】
• 午時 (11:00 AM - 01:00 PM) 養生：午時心經當令，心主血脈與藏神。午時宜小憩30分鐘（午睡養心），順應陽極陰生之氣血轉換。忌劇烈運動或大喜大怒。
• 導引按揉保養穴位：
  1. 按揉 **HT7 神門**（安神定志、治療失眠第一要穴）。
  2. 按揉 **HT5 通里**（通利舌本、治失語舌強與舌下腺炎）。
  3. 按揉 **HT3 少海**（清心瀉火、舒緩上肢抽痛）。
preservation_en:
【Heart Meridian Health Preservation & Self-Care】
• Clock Time Alignment (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM Wu Hour): Heart meridian is most active. Take a 30-minute nap during Wu Hour to nourish Heart Qi and balance Yin-Yang transition. Avoid heavy workouts or intense emotions.
• Self-Care Points: Press HT7 Shenmen (sleep & anxiety), HT5 Tongli (tongue & speech), HT3 Shaohai (clears Heart fire).
divergent_channel_zh:
【手少陰心經經別 (Heart Divergent Channel)】
• 循行路線：從手少陰經別出於淵腋兩筋之間（腋下），入走胸中，別屬心臟，向上沿喉嚨，淺出于面部，合於目內眥（合於手太陽小腸經）。
• 臨床意義：貫通心與眼睛（目系）、咽喉，上合目內眥，解釋了心火上炎致目赤、口舌生瘡與神志異常之機制。
divergent_channel_en:
【Heart Divergent Channel (Jing Bie)】
• Trajectory: Departs from main channel at axilla, enters chest, pertains to Heart, ascends along throat, emerges on face, and connects at inner canthus of eye (conjoining Small Intestine channel).
• Clinical Significance: Links Heart directly to eyes, throat, and face, explaining why Heart fire causes red eyes and tongue sores.
luo_channel_zh:
【手少陰絡脈 —— 通里 (HT5 Luo-Connecting Channel)】
• 循行路線：在腕後1寸（通里穴）分出走向手太陽小腸經；其支脈沿本經上行入心，系於舌本，屬目系。
• 病變：氣逆則發為暴瘖（突然失音）或咽喉腫痛；實證為胸脅支滿、心驚痛；虛證為不能言（失語/言語蹇澀）。取絡穴通里 (HT5) 治療。
luo_channel_en:
【Heart Luo-Connecting Vessel (Tongli HT5)】
• Trajectory: Departs from HT5 (1 cun above wrist), connects to Small Intestine channel; branch ascends to Heart, root of tongue, and eye system.
• Pathology: Rebellious Qi: Sudden loss of voice, sore throat. Excess: Fullness in chest/hypochondrium. Deficiency: Aphasia/inability to speak. Treated via HT5.
muscle_channel_zh:
【手少陰經筋 (Heart Muscle Channel / Sinew Channel)】
• 循行路線：起於手小指內側端，結於銳骨（神門掌後骨），上結於肘內側（少海），上入腋下，交手太陰經筋，伏行乳里，結於胸中，沿背部下貫膈肌，抵於臍部。
• 病候：小指轉筋疼痛、肘臂內側後緣拘急疼痛、腋下瘰癧痛、胸中拘急、伏脊抽痛。
muscle_channel_en:
【Heart Muscle Channel (Jing Jin)】
• Trajectory: Originates at little finger, binds at pisiform bone (HT7), medial elbow (HT3), axilla, chest, diaphragm, and umbilicus.
• Pathology: Cramping of little finger, pain along inner elbow/arm, axillary swelling, chest oppression, spinal cramping.
dermatome_zh:
【少陰皮部 —— 「樞儒」(Shaoyin Dermatome)】
• 少陰皮部名「樞儒」（樞者樞紐，儒者柔順）。少陰為三陰之「樞」，主心腎相交、水火既濟。邪犯少陰見心悸、怔忡、心煩失眠、舌強不語。
channel_rhyme_zh:
【手少陰心經循行歌與分寸歌】
「手少陰穴九心經，起於極泉少衝停，心胸神志咽舌病，前臂內側後廉行。
極泉腋窩動脈牽，青靈肘上三寸連，少海肘內橫紋頭，靈道掌後寸半求，
通里掌後一寸取，陰隙掌後半寸留，神門尺側銳骨陷，少府四五掌骨間，
少衝小指橈側角，九穴精微仔細看。」

points_curriculum.category: 心經起點 (Entry Point) · 局部與急救要穴
points_curriculum.location: 腋窩中央，腋動脈搏動處 (Center of axilla, on medial side of axillary artery).
points_curriculum.needling: 直刺 0.5 - 1.0 寸。⚠️ 避開腋動脈 (Avoid Axillary Artery). 可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 寬胸理氣 (Unbinds Chest)、通經活絡 (Activates Channel)、利臂止痛 (Benefits Arm).
points_curriculum.indications: 心痛、胸脅痛、瘰癧、肩臂冷痛、五十肩、腋下臭汗、手臂麻木抽搐。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】心經起點；胸痛與上肢痛要穴；避開腋動脈。

points_curriculum.category: 局部要穴 (Local Point)
points_curriculum.location: 上臂內側，少海(HT3)上3寸，肱二頭肌內側溝中 (3 cun proximal to HT3, in groove medial to biceps brachii).
points_curriculum.actions: 通經活絡 (Activates Channel)、理氣止痛 (Alleviates Pain).
points_curriculum.indications: 心痛、頭痛、目黃、脅痛、肩臂痛、帕金森/中風手顫 (Hand tremors).
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】上肢痛與手顫（帕金森氏症/中風後遺症手抖）局部要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之合穴 (He-Sea - 水穴 Water Point)
points_curriculum.location: 屈肘，肘橫紋內側端與肱骨內上髁連線中點 (Midway between medial end of cubital crease and medial epicondyle of humerus).
points_curriculum.actions: 清心安神 (Calms Spirit)、化痰瀉火 (Transforms Phlegm & Clears Heat)、通經活絡 (Activates Channel)、利音清咽 (Benefits Voice & Tongue).
points_curriculum.indications: 心痛、失眠、健忘、癲癇、暴瘖失音（突然失音）、目赤腫痛、口舌生瘡、肘臂攣痛、瘰癧。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 合穴（水穴）：清心瀉火、化痰安神（治痰火擾心致癲癇失眠）。② 突然失音與肘部攣痛要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之經穴 (Jing-River - 金穴 Metal Point)
points_curriculum.location: 前臂掌側，腕橫紋上1.5寸，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側 (1.5 cun above wrist crease, radial side of flexor carpi ulnaris tendon).
points_curriculum.actions: 寧心安神 (Calms Spirit)、通利舌本 (Benefits Voice & Tongue)、舒筋活絡 (Relaxes Sinews).
points_curriculum.indications: 心悸、心痛、失音（暴瘖）、舌強不語、悲傷善恐（臟躁症 Restless Zang Disorder）、肘臂攣痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】臟躁症（Restless Zang Disorder）與突然失音、舌強不語要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 絡穴 (Luo-Connecting Point to SI Channel)
points_curriculum.location: 前臂掌側，腕橫紋上1寸，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側 (1 cun proximal to wrist crease, radial side of flexor carpi ulnaris).
points_curriculum.actions: 通利舌本 (Benefits Tongue & Voice)、清心安神 (Calms Spirit)、調律止悸 (Regulates Heart Rhythm)、清熱止血 (Cools Blood).
points_curriculum.indications: 心悸、心律不整 (Arrhythmia)、失眠、突然失音（暴瘖）、舌強不語、口吃 (Stuttering)、月經過多、尿頻尿失禁、肘臂痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 絡穴通舌本：舌強不語、口吃、暴瘖失音第一要穴。② 心律不整與心悸。③ 移熱於小腸致尿頻尿失禁。

points_curriculum.category: 郄穴 (Xi-Cleft Point of Heart Channel) · 盜汗要穴
points_curriculum.location: 前臂掌側，腕橫紋上0.5寸，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側 (0.5 cun proximal to wrist crease, radial side of flexor carpi ulnaris).
points_curriculum.actions: 清虛熱 (Clears Deficiency Fire)、止盜汗 (Alleviates Night Sweating)、和心血 (Regulates Heart Blood)、緩急止痛 (Moderates Acute Conditions).
points_curriculum.indications: 急性心痛、心心痛（血瘀急性心絞痛）、陰虛盜汗（Night Sweating特效）、吐血、鼻衄、暴瘖、骨蒸潮熱。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 盜汗第一要穴（陰虛盜汗特效）。② 郄穴：專治急性心絞痛與心血瘀阻發作。

points_curriculum.category: 原穴 · 輸穴 (Shu-Stream - 土穴/子穴 Earth/Child Point) · 全身安神第一要穴
points_curriculum.location: 腕掌側橫紋尺側端，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側凹陷中 (Ulnar end of wrist crease, radial side of flexor carpi ulnaris).
points_curriculum.actions: 安神定志 (Calms Spirit & Mind)、補心氣血陰陽 (Regulates & Tonifies Heart)、清心火 (Clears Heart Fire)、和胃降逆 (Harmonizes Stomach).
points_curriculum.indications: 心痛、心悸、心律不整、失眠（Insomnia第一要穴）、健忘、癡呆、癲狂、悲傷欲哭、驚悸、胸脅痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 全身安神定志第一要穴：治療失眠、心悸、焦慮、健忘與神志病首選。② 原穴輸穴：補心氣、心血、心陰與心陽。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之滎穴 (Ying-Spring - 火穴/本穴 Fire Point)
points_curriculum.location: 手掌面，第4、5掌骨之間，握拳時小指尖所指處 (Between 4th & 5th metacarpals, where tip of little finger rests when making a fist).
points_curriculum.actions: 清瀉心火 (Clears Heart & SI Fire)、利下焦 (Benefits Lower Jiao)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit).
points_curriculum.indications: 心悸、胸痛、小便不利、遺尿、陰癢（外陰瘙癢）、掌心發熱、目黃、胸脅痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】本穴滎穴：清瀉心火與小腸熱（心火下移小腸致尿頻陰癢、掌心發熱）。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之井穴 (Jing-Well - 木穴/母穴 Wood/Mother Point) · 心臟急救第一要穴
points_curriculum.location: 手小指橈側，指甲角旁0.1寸 (Radial side of little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to nail corner).
points_curriculum.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或三稜針點刺出血 (Prick to bleed). 可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 開竅甦厥 (Revives Consciousness)、清心瀉火 (Clears Heat & Benefits Tongue/Eyes)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit).
points_curriculum.indications: 心絞痛、急性心肌梗塞急救 (Heart Attack Emergency)、中風昏迷、熱病發熱、心煩心痛、喉痺、舌強痛、掌心熱。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 心臟急救第一要穴（Heart attack / Stroke emergency point）：強刺激或點刺出血救逆。② 井穴：開竅甦厥。

nameEn: Small Intestine Channel of Hand Taiyang
pathway_zh: 起於小指尺側端（少澤），沿手掌尺側上行出腕（陽谷），沿前臂尺側後緣至肘（小海），沿上臂外側後緣出肩關節（肩貞），繞肩胛骨（天宗），交會於大椎，入缺盆，絡心，循食道，下膈，過胃，屬小腸。分支上頸、頰，至目外眥，折入耳中（聽宮）。另一分支至目內眥（接足太陽膀胱經）。
pathway_en: Originates at the ulnar tip of the little finger (SI 1 Shaoze), ascends the ulnar border of the hand to the wrist (SI 5 Yanggu), continues along the ulnar posterior forearm to the elbow (SI 8 Xiaohai), ascends the posterior upper arm to the shoulder (SI 9 Jianzhen), zigzags across the scapula (SI 11 Tianzong), crosses GV 14 Dazhui, enters the supraclavicular fossa, connects with the Heart, descends along the esophagus through the diaphragm to enter the Small Intestine. A branch ascends the neck and cheek to the outer canthus and enters the ear (SI 19 Tinggong). Another branch goes to the inner canthus (connecting with BL 1).
indications_zh: 頭面耳目與咽喉病症：耳鳴、耳聾、目赤腫痛、咽喉腫痛、面腫、三叉神經痛。
熱病：高熱、寒熱往來、瘧疾。
循行部位病症：頸項強痛 (落枕)、肩胛疼痛、肘臂尺側麻木疼痛。
indications_en: Head, face, ear, eye & throat disorders: Tinnitus, deafness, red eyes, sore throat, facial swelling, trigeminal neuralgia.
Febrile disorders: High fever, alternating chills and fever, malaria.
Pathway disorders: Stiff neck, scapular pain, ulnar arm/forearm pain/numbness.
applications_zh: 主司解表清熱，通經活絡，利咽開竅，散結止痛。
後谿（輸穴/八脈交會穴通督脈/治落枕脊柱痛）、聽宮（耳疾要穴）、天宗（肩胛痛與乳腺炎要穴）、少澤（井穴/通乳要穴）。
applications_en: Governs releasing the exterior, clearing heat, unblocking channels, benefiting the ears/throat, and relieving scapular pain.

Core points: SI 3 Houxi (Shu-Stream / Confluent to Du Vessel / key for stiff neck and spinal pain), SI 19 Tinggong (primary ear point), SI 11 Tianzong (scapular pain & mastitis), SI 1 Shaoze (Jing-Well / promotes lactation).
seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
進入缺盆後，沿食管兩側胸膜腔間隙下行穿膈肌，聯絡心臟，抵達胃部，屬於小腸。

【體表循行縫隙描述】
手部：起於小指尺側指甲角，沿第五掌骨尺側緣至腕部；
前臂部：行於尺側腕伸肌與尺側腕屈肌之間的縫隙，至尺骨鷹嘴與肱骨內上髁之間的凹陷（小海穴）；
上臂與肩部：沿肱三頭肌長頭與外側頭之間上行，繞岡下肌、岡上肌（天宗、秉風、曲垣），交大椎(GV14)後入缺盆；
頭頸面部：支脈循胸鎖乳突肌後緣（天窗 SI16、天容 SI17）上頰，至目銳眥入耳中（聽宮 SI19）；分支抵鼻至目內眥（接足太陽膀胱經 BL1 睛明）。
qihua_zh:
【手太陽經氣化與受盛之官】
《素問·靈蘭秘典論》曰：「小腸者，受盛之官，化物出焉。」小腸主受盛和分別清濁，將食物殘渣下送大腸，精微水液（液）下輸膀胱。

【小腸主液】
《脾胃論·卷下》云：「大腸主津，小腸主液。」小腸吸收養分精微與水液，參與人體液體代謝。小腸氣化失常見腹瀉、小腹脹痛、小便頻數或不通。
pathomechanism_zh:
【主要病候】
耳聾，目黃，頰腫，頸、頷、肩、臑、肘、臂外側後廉痛，咽喉腫痛，少腹痛，小便頻數或不通。

【《靈樞·經脈》是動病與所生病原文】
是動病：嗌痛，頷腫，不可以顧，肩拔如折，臑似折，是為臂厥。
所生病：主液所生病者，目黃，脅痛，頸頷肩臑肘臂外後廉痛。

【常見經絡異常按診切診 3 段判讀】
1. 後谿至腕骨段：原穴腕骨或後谿有硬結或極度酸痛，提示小腸積熱或頸椎/腰椎寒凝。
2. 支正段：絡穴支正處有結節或贅疣，提示手太陽經氣阻滯、疣贅生或心經失調。
3. 天宗至肩中俞段：天宗壓痛劇烈提示肩胛肌筋膜炎、乳腺增生或心胸氣滯。
pathomechanism_en:
【Small Intestine Channel Pathomechanism (Shi Dong & Suo Sheng)】
• Shi Dong Pathologies: Sore throat, swollen cheek/jaw, stiffness of neck (unable to turn head), shoulder feels broken/pulled, upper arm pain as if broken (臂厥).
• Suo Sheng Pathologies (Disorders of Liquid / 液): Yellow eyes, hypochondriac pain, pain along posterior-lateral aspect of neck, jaw, shoulder, arm, and elbow.
preservation_zh:
【小腸經日常保養與導引】
• 未時 (01:00 PM - 03:00 PM) 養生：未時小腸經當令，小腸分別清濁、吸收水液精微。未時宜多喝溫水促進腸道吸收與水分循環排毒。
• 導引按揉保養穴位：
  1. 按揉 **SI3 後谿**（通督脈、治療頸椎病、腰痛、保護視力特效穴）。
  2. 按揉 **SI11 天宗**（解肩背酸痛、通乳散結）。
  3. 按揉 **SI6 養老**（清頭明目、利肩臂痛、老年保健要穴）。
preservation_en:
【Small Intestine Meridian Health Preservation & Self-Care】
• Clock Time Alignment (1:00 - 3:00 PM Wei Hour): Small Intestine meridian is most active, separating the clear from the turbid. Drink warm water during Wei Hour to promote nutrient absorption and fluid metabolism.
• Self-Care Points: Press SI3 Houxi (cervical spine, back pain, vision), SI11 Tianzong (shoulder pain, lactation), SI6 Yanglao (eye health for elderly, joint stiffness).
divergent_channel_zh:
【手太陽小腸經經別 (Small Intestine Divergent Channel)】
• 循行路線：從肩解部（肩關節）別出，入腋走心，下巡小腸。
• 臨床意義：加強小腸與心臟之深層表裡連繫。
divergent_channel_en:
【Small Intestine Divergent Channel (Jing Bie)】
• Trajectory: Departs from shoulder joint (SI10/SI9), enters axilla, penetrates Heart, and descends to Small Intestine.
• Clinical Significance: Connects Small Intestine directly to the Heart organ.
luo_channel_zh:
【手太陽絡脈 —— 支正 (SI7 Luo-Connecting Channel)】
• 循行路線：在腕後5寸（支正穴）分出走向手少陰心經；其支脈上肘絡於肩髃部。
• 病變：實證為關節鬆弛、肘臂失用、生贅疣（疣贅/Warts/Skin tags）；虛證為皮膚生小贅疣。取絡穴支正 (SI7) 治療。
luo_channel_en:
【Small Intestine Luo-Connecting Vessel (Zhizheng SI7)】
• Trajectory: Departs from SI7 (5 cun above wrist), connects to Heart channel; branch ascends to elbow and shoulder.
• Pathology: Excess: Joint laxity, weakness of elbow/arm, warts/skin tags (贅疣). Deficiency: Small skin tags. Treated via SI7.
muscle_channel_zh:
【手太陽經筋 (Small Intestine Muscle Channel / Sinew Channel)】
• 循行路線：起於手小指尺側端，結於腕，結於肘內側，繞肩胛，上頸結於耳後，分支入耳中，上結於目銳眥，上角絡於頭頂。
• 病候：小指痛、肘內側後緣痛、肩胛痛拘急、頸項強痛、耳鳴耳痛。
muscle_channel_en:
【Small Intestine Muscle Channel (Jing Jin)】
• Trajectory: Originates at little finger, binds at wrist, elbow, scapula, neck, behind ear, enters ear, connects at outer canthus of eye, and ascends head.
• Pathology: Pain of little finger, inner elbow, scapula, stiffness of neck, tinnitus, ear pain.
dermatome_zh:
【太陽皮部 —— 「關樞」(Taiyang Dermatome)】
• 太陽皮部名「關樞」（關者主表，樞者運轉）。太陽為三陽之「關」，主一身之表，外感邪氣首犯太陽。
channel_rhyme_zh:
【手太陽小腸經循行歌與分寸歌】
「手太陽穴十九經，起於少澤聽宮終，頭面五官熱神志，肩臂後廉液病同。
少澤小指尺甲角，前谷節前陷中求，後谿節後橫紋頭，腕骨腕前骨陷取，
陽谷腕後銳骨下，養老轉拳骨縫瞅，支正腕上五寸取，小海肘內兩骨間，
肩貞腋後一寸許，臑俞肩髃後陷間，天宗岡下窩中陷，秉風岡上舉臂填，
曲垣岡內端陷處，肩外俞在二肋邊，肩中俞在大椎旁，天窗肌後結喉平，
天容耳下肌前陷，顴髎面頰顴骨下，聽宮耳屏前陷中，十九穴名仔細考。」

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之井穴 (Jing-Well - 金穴 Metal Point) · 催乳第一要穴
points_curriculum.location: 手小指尺側，指甲角旁0.1寸 (Ulnar side of little finger, 0.1 cun posterior to nail corner).
points_curriculum.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血 (Prick to bleed)。可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 通乳消腫 (Promotes Lactation & Benefits Breasts)、清熱開竅 (Clears Heat & Revives Consciousness)、利頭面五官 (Benefits Sensory Orifices).
points_curriculum.indications: 產後缺乳（乳少）、乳腺炎（乳癰）、急性咽喉腫痛、舌強、耳鳴耳痛、高熱昏迷、頭痛、目赤腫痛、手指麻木。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 產後催乳第一要穴（缺乳/乳少/乳腺炎）。② 井穴刺血急救高熱失音。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之滎穴 (Ying-Spring - 水穴 Water Point)
points_curriculum.location: 微握拳，手小指尺側，第5掌指關節前下方赤白肉際凹陷中 (Ulnar end of crease in front of 5th MCP joint).
points_curriculum.actions: 疏風清熱 (Clears Wind-Heat)、消腫止痛 (Reduces Swelling & Alleviates Pain)、利耳目項背 (Benefits Ears, Eyes & Neck).
points_curriculum.indications: 頭痛、項強痛（頸椎拉傷/落枕）、耳鳴耳聾、目赤腫痛、咽喉腫痛、產後缺乳、小便赤澀。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】滎穴清風熱：頸椎扭傷落枕與耳目風熱腫痛。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之輸穴 (Shu-Stream - 木穴/母穴) · 八脈交會穴 (通督脈 Du Mai - 配申脈 BL62)
points_curriculum.location: 微握拳，第5掌指關節後下方尺側，掌橫紋頭赤白肉際凹陷中 (Ulnar end of distal palmar crease, proximal to 5th MCP joint).
points_curriculum.actions: 通調督脈 (Regulates Governing Vessel)、疏風清熱 (Clears Wind-Heat)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel & Alleviates Pain)、清心安神 (Calms Spirit & Treats Epilepsy)、止盜汗 (Alleviates Night Sweats w/ HT6).
points_curriculum.indications: 頭痛、頸項強痛、急性腰扭傷（特效）、脊柱痛、肩背痛、手臂手指麻木攣急、癲癇、瘧疾、盜汗（配陰隙 HT6）、目赤腫痛、耳鳴耳聾、發熱無汗。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 通督脈第一要穴（八脈交會穴配申脈 BL62）：頸椎病、急性腰扭傷、脊柱痛與姿勢矯正在線特效。② 治癲癇與盜汗（配 HT6 陰隙）。

points_curriculum.category: 原穴 (Yuan-Source Point of Small Intestine Channel)
points_curriculum.location: 手掌尺側，第5掌骨基底部與三角骨之間的凹陷中，赤白肉際處 (In depression between base of 5th metacarpal & hamate/triquetral bone).
points_curriculum.actions: 疏太陽邪熱 (Clears Heat & Reduces Swelling)、退黃疸 (Benefits Jaundice)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel).
points_curriculum.indications: 黃疸、膽囊炎、頭痛、頸項強痛、手腕手掌腫痛、熱病、退行性關節痛、頷腫。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 原穴：退黃疸（Jaundice）要穴。② 腕部與手部痛。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之經穴 (Jing-River - 火穴/本穴 Fire Point)
points_curriculum.location: 腕背側尺側，尺骨莖突與三角骨之間的凹陷中 (At ulnar end of wrist crease, between styloid process of ulna & triquetral bone).
points_curriculum.actions: 清熱瀉火 (Clears Heat & Reduces Swelling)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit)、利腕關節 (Benefits Wrist).
points_curriculum.indications: 頭痛、目眩、耳鳴耳聾、齒痛、頷腫、手腕痛、肩臂痛、狂躁神志病、小兒驚風。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】本穴（火穴）：清熱瀉火、手腕局部痛。

points_curriculum.category: 郄穴 (Xi-Cleft Point of Small Intestine Channel) · 老年眼疾要穴
points_curriculum.location: 前臂背側尺側，掌心向胸時，尺骨莖突橈側骨縫凹陷中 (When palm faces chest, in bony cleft on radial side of styloid process of ulna).
points_curriculum.needling: 向肘部斜刺 0.5 - 0.8 寸。可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 明目退翳 (Benefits Eyes & Failing Vision)、舒筋通絡 (Activates Channel & Alleviates Pain)、緩和急性痛 (Moderates Acute Conditions).
points_curriculum.indications: 目視不明（老花眼、白內障、視力減退）、肩背肘臂痛、急性腰扭傷、頸項強痛、上肢癱瘓無力。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 老年眼疾要穴（視力減退、老花眼、白內障）。② 郄穴：急性肩背痛與急性腰痛。

points_curriculum.category: 絡穴 (Luo-Connecting Point to Heart Channel) · 贅疣特效穴
points_curriculum.location: 前臂背側尺側，陽谷(SI5)與小海(SI8)連線上，腕背橫紋上5寸 (5 cun proximal to wrist crease on SI5-SI8 line).
points_curriculum.actions: 祛風清熱 (Clears Heat & Releases Exterior)、消贅疣 (Treats Warts/Skin Tags)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel).
points_curriculum.indications: 贅疣（扁平疣/尋常疣/Skin tags/Warts特效）、頭痛、項強痛、肘臂酸痛、熱病、狂躁、癲癇、肘臂無力。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 贅疣（Warts / Skin tags）第一特效穴（絡穴通心，氣滯生贅）。② 兼清頭面風熱與神志病。

points_curriculum.category: 五輸穴之合穴 (He-Sea - 土穴/子穴 Earth/Child Point)
points_curriculum.location: 屈肘，尺骨鷹嘴與肱骨內上髁之間的凹陷中 (In depression between olecranon process of ulna & medial epicondyle of humerus).
points_curriculum.actions: 清熱散結 (Clears Heat & Dissipates Swelling)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel & Alleviates Pain)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit).
points_curriculum.indications: 肘臂疼痛麻木（尺神經麻痺/痛）、頸項肩背痛、癲癇、瘰癧、齒齦腫痛、頰腫。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 瀉穴（子穴）：清瀉小腸經與心經熱。② 肘部尺神經痛（Ulnar nerve pain）與肘關節攣急。

points_curriculum.category: 肩部要穴 (Shoulder Local Point)
points_curriculum.location: 肩關節後下方，臂內收時，腋後紋頭直上1寸 (1 cun above posterior end of axillary fold when arm adducted).
points_curriculum.actions: 祛風利濕 (Expels Wind)、利肩關節 (Benefits Shoulder)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩背疼痛、肩關節周圍炎（五十肩）、上肢不遂、手麻痛、瘰癧、肩部腫脹。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】五十肩（肩周炎）與肩背痛要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 手太陽經與陽維脈、陽貎脈交會穴
points_curriculum.location: 肩部，腋後紋頭直上，肩胛岡下緣凹陷中 (Directly above posterior end of axillary fold, inferior to scapular spine).
points_curriculum.actions: 利肩關節 (Benefits Shoulder)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩臂疼痛、肩關節活動受限、瘰癧、肩腫痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】肩關節痛與活動受限。

points_curriculum.category: 肩胛與乳疾第一要穴 (Primary Scapular & Breast Point)
points_curriculum.location: 肩胛區，天宗凹陷中，岡下窩中央，約第4胸椎棘突平齊 (In depression center of subscapular fossa, level with T4).
points_curriculum.actions: 通絡止痛 (Activates Channel & Alleviates Pain)、寬胸理氣 (Unbinds Chest)、通乳散結 (Benefits Breasts & Promotes Lactation).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩胛疼痛（肩胛肌筋膜炎特效）、肩背僵硬痛、頸項強痛、乳腺炎（乳癰）、產後缺乳（乳少）、乳房脹痛（乳癖）、咳嗽、氣喘、胸脅痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 肩胛痛與肌筋膜痛第一要穴。② 婦科乳腺炎與產後催乳要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 手太陽經、手陽明經、足少陽經、手少陽經交會穴
points_curriculum.location: 肩胛區，岡上窩中央，天宗(SI11)直上方 (In center of suprascapular fossa, directly above SI11).
points_curriculum.actions: 祛風通絡 (Expels Wind)、利肩胛 (Benefits Shoulder & Scapula).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩胛疼痛、肩臂痠麻、舉臂困難。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】祛風止痛，治肩胛痛舉臂困難。

points_curriculum.category: 局部要穴 (Local Point)
points_curriculum.location: 肩胛區，岡上窩內側端 (On medial extremity of suprascapular fossa).
points_curriculum.actions: 通絡止痛 (Benefits Shoulder & Scapula).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩胛崗內側痛、肩背拘急疼痛。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】肩胛內側痛與肩背拘急。

points_curriculum.category: 局部要穴 (Local Point)
points_curriculum.location: 背部，第1胸椎棘突下旁開3寸 (3 cun lateral to lower border of spinous process of T1).
points_curriculum.needling: 斜刺 0.3 - 0.7 寸。⚠️ 避免向內深刺。可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 祛風散寒 (Expels Wind & Cold)、通絡止痛 (Benefits Shoulder & Scapula).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩背疼痛、頸項強痛、上肢酸麻。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】風寒肩背痛與頸項強痛。

points_curriculum.category: 局部要穴 (Local Point)
points_curriculum.location: 背部，第7頸椎棘突下旁開2寸 (2 cun lateral to lower border of spinous process of C7).
points_curriculum.needling: 斜刺 0.3 - 0.6 寸。⚠️ 避免深刺。可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 宣肺降氣 (Descends Lung Qi)、通絡止痛 (Activates Channel).
points_curriculum.indications: 肩背痛、頸項強痛、咳嗽、氣喘、視物模糊、唾血。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】肩背痛與咳嗽氣喘。

points_curriculum.category: 天牖五部/天窗穴 (Window of the Sky Point)
points_curriculum.location: 頸外側部，胸鎖乳突肌後緣，扶突(LI18)後方，平結喉 (In lateral neck, posterior to SCM, level with Adam's apple).
points_curriculum.actions: 聰耳利咽 (Benefits Ears, Throat & Voice)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit)、清熱散結 (Clears Heat & Disperses Swelling).
points_curriculum.indications: 耳鳴、耳聾、暴瘖失音（突然失音）、咽喉腫痛、頸項強痛、瘰癧、癭氣、癲癇。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】天窗穴：耳鳴耳聾與突然失音、瘰癧要穴。

points_curriculum.category: 天牖五部/天窗穴 · 手太陽經與手少陽經交會穴
points_curriculum.location: 頸部，下頜角後方，胸鎖乳突肌前緣凹陷中 (Posterior to angle of mandible, anterior border of SCM).
points_curriculum.needling: 直刺 0.5 - 0.7 寸。⚠️ 避免深刺頸動脈。⚠️ 禁灸 (No Moxa).
points_curriculum.actions: 利咽聰耳 (Benefits Throat & Ears)、降逆散結 (Descends Rebellious Qi & Disperses Swelling).
points_curriculum.indications: 咽喉腫痛、暴瘖失音、耳鳴耳聾、瘰癧、癭氣、頰腫、頸項強痛、扁桃體炎。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】天窗穴：咽喉腫痛、扁桃體炎與耳鳴耳聾；禁灸。

points_curriculum.category: 手太陽經與手少陽經交會穴 · 面疾要穴
points_curriculum.location: 面部，目外眥直下方，顴骨下緣凹陷中 (Directly below outer canthus, in depression on lower border of zygoma).
points_curriculum.needling: 直刺或斜刺 0.5 - 0.8 寸。⚠️ 禁灸 (No Moxa).
points_curriculum.actions: 祛風止痛 (Eliminates Wind & Alleviates Pain)、消腫正歪 (Reduces Swelling & Facial Spasm).
points_curriculum.indications: 口眼歪斜（面癱）、三叉神經痛、面肌痙攣、齒痛（上頜牙痛）、頰腫、目黃、眼瞼瞤動。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】面癱、三叉神經痛與上頜牙痛第一要穴；禁灸。

points_curriculum.category: 手太陽經、手少陽經與足少陽經交會穴 · 耳病第一要穴
points_curriculum.location: 面部耳屏前，下頜骨髁突後方，張口時呈凹陷處 (Anterior to tragus, in depression formed when mouth open).
points_curriculum.needling: 張口取穴，直刺 0.5 - 1.0 寸。可灸。
points_curriculum.actions: 聰耳通竅 (Benefits Ears & Opens Orifices)、安神定志 (Calms Spirit)、利顳顎關節 (Benefits Mandibular Joint).
points_curriculum.indications: 耳鳴、耳聾、聤耳（中耳炎耳腫流膿）、耳道痛、齒痛、顳顎關節紊亂 (TMJ)、癲癇、狂躁。
points_curriculum.notes: 【課件考綱精華】① 耳病第一要穴（耳鳴耳聾中耳炎）：張口取穴。② 常配耳門 TE21、聽會 GB2 三聽穴。

pathway_zh: 起於目內眥（睛明），交會額頂（百會），分支至耳上角。直行支從頂入絡腦，出別下項（天柱），分兩支沿脊柱兩側下行。內側支（第一側線）下行挾脊（距離脊柱1.5寸），貫脊，絡腎，屬膀胱。外側支（第二側線）挾脊3寸下行，過臀部，兩支會合於膕窩中（委中）。下行貫腓腸肌（承山），出外踝後（崑崙），沿小趾外側端（至陰，接足少陰腎經）。
pathway_en: Originates at the inner canthus of the eye (BL 1 Jingming), ascends across the forehead to the vertex (GV 20 Baihui). A branch enters the brain and emerges at the nape (BL 10 Tianzhu), dividing into two parallel lines down the back: the inner line (1.5 cun lateral) descends through the lumbar region to connect with the Kidney and enter the Bladder. The outer line (3 cun lateral) descends past the buttock. Both lines join at the popliteal fossa (BL 40 Weizhong), descend through the calf (BL 57 Chengshan), pass behind the lateral malleolus (BL 60 Kunlun), and terminate at the lateral tip of the 5th toe (BL 67 Zhiyin, connecting with KI 1).
indications_zh: 頭面五官病症：頭痛（後頭痛/頂頭痛）、目赤腫痛、鼻塞流涕、眩暈。
臟腑與全身病症：五臟六腑背俞穴主治各相關臟腑病變、高熱、感冒發熱。
循行部位病症：項強痛、脊柱僵硬、腰痛、坐骨神經痛、膕窩痛、小腿抽筋、足跟痛。
indications_en: Head, face & sensory organ disorders: Occipital/vertex headache, red eyes, nasal congestion, vertigo.
Zang-Fu & systemic disorders: Back-Shu points treat all internal organ pathologies; high fever, common cold.
Pathway disorders: Stiff neck, spinal pain, lumbar pain/sciatica, popliteal pain, calf muscle cramps, heel pain.
applications_zh: 主司疏風解表，清頭明目，通調太陽經氣，調理五臟六腑機能，止痛通絡。
委中（合穴/四總穴腰背委中求/清血熱）、背俞穴群（BL13-BL28 肺俞心俞肝俞脾俞腎俞等）、崑崙（經穴/難產急救/項背痛要穴）、申脈（八脈交會穴通陽蹻脈）、至陰（井穴/矯正胎位要穴）。
applications_en: Governs expelling wind and releasing the exterior, clearing head/eyes, regulating Taiyang Qi, treating organ disorders via Back-Shu points, and relieving back/leg pain.

Core points: BL 40 Weizhong (He-Sea / Command point for back & lumbar), Back-Shu series (BL 13 Feishu, BL 15 Xinshu, BL 18 Ganshu, BL 20 Pishu, BL 23 Shenshu), BL 60 Kunlun (neck/back pain & difficult labor), BL 62 Shenmai (Confluent to Yangqiao Vessel), BL 67 Zhiyin (Jing-Well / correcting fetal malposition).
seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
從腰肌縫隙進入腹腔後，沿腹膜腔間隙到達並聯絡腎，向前至膀胱處的腹膜間隙聯屬膀胱。

【體表循行縫隙描述】
(1)頭面部體表循行縫隙:足太陽膀胱經，起於內眼角，沿額肌內側緣上額，與督脈交於頭頂部。頭部分支:從頭頂向兩側行至耳郭上方。
(2)軀幹部體表循行縫隙(第一側線):從頭頂部進入顱腔聯絡腦，返回後項部，沿斜方肌外側邊緣和豎脊肌第二列最長肌與髂肋肌之間的間隙到達腰部，沿此縫隙進入體腔內。
(3)腰部支脈體表循行縫隙:從豎脊肌最長肌與髂肋肌之間的間隙向下沿脊柱兩側的肌肉縫隙貫臀部，向下行於大腿後側正中股二頭肌與半膜肌、半腱肌之間的縫隙到達腘窩正中。
(4)肩頸部支脈體表循行縫隙(第二側線):(軀幹部)從肩胛骨內側緣向下，沿著髂肋肌外緣與後鋸肌之間的縫隙向下至腰部，沿臀大肌與臀中肌、小肌之間的縫隙下行，與少陽經交會;(大腿部)沿股二頭肌外側緣與髂脛束之間的縫隙下行至腘窩外側緣，與第一側線合於委中穴;(小腿部)委中至承山段行於腓腸肌兩肌腹之間，飛揚至崑崙段行於腓腸肌外側肌腹前緣與比目魚肌之間的縫隙，爾後行於跟腱與腓骨長短肌肌腱之間;(足部)沿跟骨下緣，行於第五跖骨粗隆下與足外側肌之間至第五腳趾外側指甲角。
qihua_zh:
【足太陽經氣化與淨腑水府】
足太陽經，內屬膀胱，外行於睛明到至陰的縫隙中，通過足太陽經別加強對膀胱、腎的調節作用。膀胱又稱淨腑、水府、玉海、脬、尿胞。位於下腹部，在臟腑中，居最下處。《素問·靈蘭秘典論》曰：「膀胱者，州都之官，津液藏焉，氣化則能出矣。」說明足太陽經是人體水液儲存、分流、化氣成水或化水成氣的重要路徑，依靠腎氣的鼓動，並與手少陽三焦經共同行使此種功能。

【影響足太陽經氣化的因素】
主要有兩方面：一是膀胱藏津液的功能發生障礙，出現諸如癃閉、腫脹、尿頻、遺溺等病症；二是足太陽經在經絡循行路徑上的經氣運行出現障礙而發作的一些筋病，例如項、背、腰、尻、腘腨、腳皆痛等，都會出現足太陽經絡異常，集中在委中、飛揚、申脈、金門、京骨等處出現結絡或者結塊。

足太陽經氣化主要功能：貯存尿液、排泄小便、藏津液，化氣固表。
pathomechanism_zh:
【主要病候】
1.臟腑病證：十二臟腑及其相關組織器官病證。
2.神志病：癲、狂、癇等。
3.頭面五官病：頭痛、鼻塞、鼻衄等。
4.經脈循行部位的其他病證：項、背、腰、下肢病證等。

【《靈樞·經脈》是動病與所生病原文】
主要病症 (是動病)：頭重痛，眼睛似將脫出，後項強直，脊背痛，腰似折斷，股關節不能彎曲，腘窩好像凝結，腓腸肌如要裂開；還可發生外踝部的氣血阻逆，如脈冷、麻木等症。
相關病症 (主筋所生病)：本經所屬腧穴能主治有關“筋”方面所發生的病症：痔，瘧疾，躁狂、癲癇，頭腦後項痛，眼睛昏黃，流淚，鼻塞，多涕或出血，後項、背腰部、骶尾部、膝彎、腓腸肌、腳都可發生病痛，小腳趾不好運用。

【常見經絡異常按診 11 段判讀】
1.循推背俞穴：若有硬結或腫物或壓痛，大多與相應臟腑有關。
2.膝以下循推時，首先從至陰、足通谷、束骨往上循推，如果在京骨、束骨出現小的沙粒狀結節或結塊，均提示足太陽膀胱經異常，一般屬於虛寒證。
3.至陰至飛揚的異常變化：提示腰椎病變，急性腰痛多有沙粒狀改變。
4.至陰至束骨：沙粒狀結節、結絡，提示腰背部肌肉的損傷、拉傷。
5.京骨若出現酸痛、鬆軟，表示足太陽經氣虛，如腰痛、腰酸無力、尿頻、憋尿不能。
6.在金門處若出現結節，提示經氣不順暢，如頭痛、泌尿系結石、腰痛、急性頭痛。
7.申脈出現結絡或結節，常提示腰痛、頭痛、共濟失調性步態。
8.崑崙處有結節，提示頭痛、眼部疾患。
9.委中有壓痛、結節、結絡或出現浮絡（異常突起靜脈），提示足太陽膀胱經循行部的腰背部肌肉、韌帶、筋腱有瘀血，或者有位置的異常，如偏歪、扭轉。
10.在殷門和承扶處肌肉較厚，如果在深部循摸到有棱角的結塊，要考慮是否有膀胱癌或前列腺癌，可建議患者做一些相關檢查。
11.足太陽膀胱經的經絡異常主要反映三方面的疾病：
第一：臟腑病。背部的背俞穴都在膀胱經上，臟腑有疾，五臟六腑的相關背俞穴可出現異常。
第二：頸、背、脊、腰部肌肉、筋腱、韌帶問題。如果頸項部、背、脊、腰或腰骶部出現僵硬、強直，一般提示足太陽膀胱經有寒濕。
第三：泌尿系感染或結石，會在足太陽膀胱經上出現異常。
pathomechanism_en:
【Bladder Channel Pathomechanism (Shi Dong & Suo Sheng)】
• Shi Dong Pathologies: Severe headache, sensation of eyes popping out, rigid nape, spinal pain, lumbar feeling split, rigid hip joints, popliteal feeling bound, calf feeling split, arm/leg Bi-syndrome.
• Suo Sheng Pathologies (Disorders of Sinews / 筋): Hemorrhoids, malaria, mania, epilepsy, posterior head/neck pain, yellow eyes, tearing, nasal congestion/epistaxis, pain along neck, back, sacrum, popliteal area, calf, foot, and inability to use little toe.
preservation_zh:
【膀胱經日常保養與導引】
• 申時(15:00~17:00)養生：申時是膀胱經當令，膀胱負責貯藏水液和津液,水液排出體外，津液循環在體內，此時宜適時飲水。申時體溫較高，陰虛的人最為突出。此時適當活動有助於體內津液循環,喝滋陰瀉火的茶水對陰虛的人最有效。
• 脊柱與腿部推捏敲打：膀胱經從頭頂到足部左右共134穴，可用雙手拇指和食指捏住脊柱兩邊肌肉(或用掌根)儘可能從頸椎一直推到尾骨，然後十指並攏,按住脊柱向上推回到開始的位置；腿部的膀胱經可用點揉或敲打的方式充分刺激穴位。每日1次，每次反復推幾遍。
• 禁忌：飲水後一定不要憋小便,否則不利於排毒。另外，午時睡個午覺，有利於保證申時精力充沛。
preservation_en:
【Bladder Meridian Health Preservation & Self-Care】
• Clock Time Alignment (3:00 - 5:00 PM Shen Hour): Bladder meridian is most active. Drink warm water during Shen Hour to facilitate fluid circulation and waste excretion.
• Self-Care Massage & Tapping: Perform spinal kneading or rolling from C7 down to sacrum daily. Tap along the posterior thigh and calf to activate Bladder Qi.
• Cautions: Avoid holding urine after drinking water. Take a midday nap to maintain high energy during Shen Hour.
divergent_channel_zh:
【足太陽膀胱經經別 (Bladder Divergent Channel)】
• 循行路線：從足太陽經脈的腘窩部分出，其中一條支脈在骶骨下五寸處別行進入肛門，上行歸屬膀胱，散布聯絡腎臟，沿脊柱兩旁的肌肉到心臟後散布於心臟內；直行的一條支脈，從脊柱兩旁的肌肉處繼續上行，淺出項部，脈氣仍注入足太陽本經。
• 分段結構：
  • 別入：于腘中，其一道行至尻下五寸處，別行入於肛門。
  • 別行：屬於膀胱，散於腎，當心入散，系舌本。
  • 出合：從膂上出於項。
  • 合於：足太陽。
divergent_channel_en:
【Bladder Divergent Channel (Jing Bie)】
• Trajectory: Branches in popliteal fossa, ascends to sacrum, enters anus, pertains to Bladder, spreads in Kidneys, ascends along spine to Heart, and emerges at neck to rejoin main Bladder channel.
• Clinical Significance: Connects Bladder channel deeply to Heart, Kidney, Bladder, and anal region.
luo_channel_zh:
【足太陽絡脈 —— 飛揚 (BL58 Luo-Connecting Channel)】
• 循行與病變：足太陽膀胱經的別行絡脈，名曰飛揚，在外踝上7寸處分出，走向足少陰腎經。其病變，實證為鼻塞流涕、頭背部疼痛，虛證為鼻流清涕、鼻衄，可取其絡穴飛揚治療。
luo_channel_en:
【Bladder Luo-Connecting Vessel (Feiyang BL58)】
• Trajectory: Departs at BL58 (7 cun above lateral malleolus), connects to Kidney channel.
• Pathology: Excess: Nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, head & back pain. Deficiency: Clear nasal discharge, epistaxis. Treated via BL58.
muscle_channel_zh:
【足太陽經筋 (Bladder Muscle Channel / Sinew Channel)】
• 循行路線：起於足小趾爪甲的外側，向上結於外踝，再斜向上結聚於膝部，在足背外側循行的一支結於足跟，上沿跟腱結於腘部；從外踝分出的一支，結於腨外（腓腸肌部），上行至腘窩內側緣，與腘部的一支並行上結於臀部；向上經軀幹挾於脊柱兩旁到項部；由此分出一支別入於內，結於舌根；直行的一支從項上結於枕骨，經頭頂行到顏面，結於鼻；再由鼻部分出維絡上眼瞼，形成目上綱，然後向下結於鼻旁；背部的分支，從腋後外側結於肩髃部；另一支從腋後進入腋下，向上繞行出於缺盆，上結於耳後顳骨乳突；還有一支從缺盆分出，斜向上結於鼻旁顴骨部，與從頭巔下行至顴部的分支相會合。
muscle_channel_en:
【Bladder Muscle Channel (Jing Jin)】
• Trajectory: Originates at 5th toe, binds at lateral malleolus, heel, knee, popliteal, gluteus, spine, neck, tongue root, occiput, and connects over upper eyelid forming Eye Upper Lid (目上綱).
• Pathology: Eye lid twitching/ptosis, cramping along heel, calf, popliteal, gluteus, back, and neck.
dermatome_zh:
【太陽皮部 —— 「關樞」(Taiyang Dermatome)】
• 太陽皮部名「關樞」（關者衛固也，太陽為三陽之關，主一身之表，統營衛而應皮毛，是衛外屏障，為諸經之藩籬）。
• 病理機制：陽氣衛外而為固，外邪侵犯人體，太陽經首先受病。《黃帝內經靈樞·百病始生》說：「是故虛邪之中人也，始於皮膚，皮膚緩則腠理開，開則邪從毛發入……」外邪束表，正氣向外抗邪，出現惡寒發熱，脈浮，頭項強痛。治當解表，善治者治皮毛。
channel_rhyme_zh:
【足太陽膀胱經循行歌與六十七穴分寸歌】
「BL六十七膀胱經，起於睛明至陰終，臟腑頭面筋痔腰，熱病神志身后憑。
內眦上外是睛明，眉頭陷中攢竹取，眉衝直上旁神庭，曲差庭旁一寸半，
五處直後上星平，承光通天絡卻穴，后行俱是寸半程，玉枕腦戶旁寸三，
天柱筋外平啞門，再下脊旁寸半尋，第一大杼二風門，三椎肺俞四厥陰，
心五督六膈俞七，九肝十膽仔細分，十一脾俞十二胃，十三三焦十四腎，
氣海十五大腸六，七八關元小腸俞，十九膀胱廿中膂，廿一椎旁白環俞，
上次中下四髎穴，骶骨兩旁骨陷中，尾骨之旁會陽穴，承扶臀下橫紋中，
殷門扶下六寸當，浮郄委陽上一寸，委陽腘窩外筋旁，委中腘窩紋中央，
第二側線再細詳，以下夾脊開三寸，二三附分魄戶當，四椎膏肓神堂五，
六七譩譆膈關藏，第九魂門陽綱十，十一意舍二胃倉，十三肓門四志室，
十九胞膏廿一秩邊，小腿各穴牢牢記，紋下二寸尋合陽，紋下五寸承筋當，
承山腨下分肉藏，飛揚外踝上七寸，跗陽踝上三寸良，崑崙外踝跟腱間，
仆參昆下跟骨外，外踝下緣申脈穴，踝前骰陷金門鄉，大骨前下尋京骨，
關節之後束骨良，通谷節前陷中好，至陰小趾外甲角。六十七穴分三段，

paired_channel: BL (Bladder Channel / 足太陽膀胱經)
pathway_zh: 起於小趾下，斜趨足心（湧泉），出舟骨粗隆下，循內踝後（太溪），別入跟中，上腓腸肌內側，出膕窩內側（陰谷），上股內後廉，貫脊屬腎，絡膀胱。直行支從腎上貫肝膈，入肺中，沿喉嚨，挾舌本。分支從肺出絡心，注胸中（接手厥陰心包經）。
pathway_en: Originates beneath the 5th toe, crosses the sole diagonally to KI 1 Yongquan, emerges below the navicular tuberosity, passes behind the medial malleolus (KI 3 Taixi), enters the heel, ascends the medial calf to the medial knee crease (KI 10 Yingu), continues up the posterior medial thigh into the abdomen/spine to enter the Kidney and connect with the Bladder. An ascending branch passes through the liver/diaphragm into the lungs, along the throat, and terminates at the tongue base. Another branch departs from the lungs to connect with the Heart (connecting with PC 1).
indications_zh: 腎虛與泌尿生殖病症：遺精、陽痿、不孕、月經不調、水腫、小便不利、遺尿、小便頻數。
肺腎氣虛與五官病症：氣喘、久咳、耳鳴、耳聾、咽喉乾痛、牙齒鬆動、目眩。
神志病症：失眠、健忘、驚悸、恐懼症。
循行部位病症：腰膝酸痛、下肢痿痺、足心熱疼痛。
indications_en: Kidney deficiency & urogenital disorders: Nocturnal emissions, impotence, infertility, dysmenorrhea, edema, dysuria, enuresis, urinary frequency.
Lung-Kidney deficiency & sensory organ disorders: Chronic asthma/cough, tinnitus, deafness, dry/sore throat, loose teeth, dizziness.
Mental & Shen disorders: Insomnia, amnesia, palpitations, fear/anxiety.
Pathway disorders: Lumbar & knee soreness/pain, lower extremity weakness, heat/pain in soles.
applications_zh: 主司滋陰補腎，培元固本，納氣平喘，清熱利水，安神定志。
太溪（原穴/補腎第一要穴）、湧泉（井穴/開竅急救/滋陰降火）、照海（八脈交會穴通陰蹻脈/治咽喉痛與失眠）、復溜（經穴/止汗止瀉要穴）。
applications_en: Governs nourishing Yin and tonifying Kidneys, grasping Qi to relieve asthma, draining water/edema, and calming the Shen.

Core points: KI 3 Taixi (Yuan-Source / primary Kidney tonic), KI 1 Yongquan (Jing-Well / descends Fire & opens orifices), KI 6 Zhaohai (Confluent to Yinqiao Vessel / sore throat & insomnia), KI 7 Fuliu (Jing-River / regulates sweating & water metabolism).

paired_channel: TE (Triple Burner Channel / 手少陽三焦經)
pathway_zh: 起於胸中，出屬心包絡，下膈，歷絡上、中、下三焦。分支從胸中出脅下（天池），上行至腋下，沿上臂內側正中下行，至肘窩中（曲澤），沿前臂內側兩筋之間（內關、大陵），入掌中（勞宮），出中指端（中衝）。分支從掌中分出，出無名指尺側端（接手少陽三焦經）。
pathway_en: Originates in the chest, enters the Pericardium, descends through the diaphragm to connect with the Upper, Middle, and Lower Jiao. A branch emerges laterally at PC 1 Tianchi, ascends to the axilla, descends along the midline of the anterior arm to the elbow crease (PC 3 Quze), continues down between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis (PC 6 Neiguan, PC 7 Daling) into the palm (PC 8 Laogong), and terminates at the tip of the middle finger (PC 9 Zhongchong). A branch departs from the palm to the ulnar tip of the ring finger (connecting with TE 1).
indications_zh: 心胸與血管病症：心悸、心痛、胸心悶痛、氣短、心律失常。
胃腸與神志病症：嘔吐、打嗝、胃痛、反胃、失眠、焦慮、癲狂、高熱神昏。
循行部位病症：腋下腫痛、肘臂拘急麻木、掌心發熱。
indications_en: Cardiovascular & chest disorders: Palpitations, cardiac pain, chest tightness/pain, shortness of breath, arrhythmia.
Gastrointestinal & Shen disorders: Nausea, vomiting, hiccups, gastralgia, severe insomnia, anxiety, coma, febrile delirium.
Pathway disorders: Axillary swelling/pain, elbow/arm spasms/numbness, heat in palms.
applications_zh: 主司寬胸理氣，和胃降逆，寧心安神，清熱瀉火，解鬱開竅。
內關（絡穴/八脈交會穴通陰維脈/四總穴心胸內關謀/止嘔第一要穴）、大陵（原穴/清心火/治口臭）、曲澤（合穴/瀉心包熱）、中衝（井穴/急救甦厥）。
applications_en: Governs expanding the chest, harmonizing Stomach to lower rebellious Qi, calming Shen, clearing heat/fire, and opening orifices.

Core points: PC 6 Neiguan (Luo-Connecting / Confluent to Yinwei Vessel / Command point for chest & heart / primary anti-emetic point), PC 7 Daling (Yuan-Source / clears Heart Fire & bad breath), PC 3 Quze (He-Sea / clears Pericardium heat), PC 9 Zhongchong (Jing-Well / resuscitation).

nameEn: Triple Burner Channel of Hand Shaoyang
paired_channel: PC (Pericardium Channel / 手厥陰心包經)
pathway_zh: 起於無名指尺側端（關衝），沿手背兩骨之間，過腕背（陽池），沿前臂外側正中出肘外側（天井），沿上臂外側上肩，交大椎，入缺盆，布膻中，散絡心包，下膈，遍屬上、中、下三焦。分支從膻中上出缺盆，上頸，連耳後，直上出耳上角，折下至面頰，抵目眶下。另一分支從耳後入耳中，出走耳前，至目外眥（接足少陽膽經）。
pathway_en: Originates at the ulnar tip of the ring finger (TE 1 Guanchong), ascends between the 4th/5th metacarpals to the wrist (TE 4 Yangchi), continues up the midline of the posterior forearm to the elbow (TE 10 Tianjing), ascends the posterior upper arm to the shoulder, crosses GV 14 Dazhui, enters the supraclavicular fossa, spreads in the chest to connect with the Pericardium, and passes down through Upper, Middle, and Lower Jiao. A branch ascends the neck to behind the ear, loops over the head to the cheek. Another branch enters the ear and emerges in front of it to end at the outer canthus (connecting with GB 1).
indications_zh: 頭面耳目與少陽病症：耳鳴、耳聾、中耳炎、目赤腫痛、偏頭痛、面癱、偏頭痛、寒熱往來。
熱病與咽喉症：高熱、咽喉腫痛、痄腮（腮腺炎）、喉痺。
循行部位病症：肩背痛、肘臂痛、肩關節活動障礙。
indications_en: Head, face, ear, eye & Shaoyang disorders: Tinnitus, deafness, otitis media, red eyes, temporal migraine, Bell's palsy, alternating chills/fever.
Febrile & throat disorders: High fever, sore throat, mumps, hoarseness.
Pathway disorders: Shoulder/back pain, elbow/arm pain, restricted shoulder joint mobility.
applications_zh: 主司清熱解毒，疏解少陽，通利三焦，聰耳明目，通經活絡。
外關（絡穴/八脈交會穴通帶脈/清熱解表要穴）、支溝（經穴/通便要穴/治脅痛）、耳門與翳風（耳疾要穴）、陽池（原穴）。
applications_en: Governs clearing heat, harmonizing Shaoyang, unblocking the Three Jiao, benefiting ears/eyes, and relieving channel obstruction.

Core points: TE 5 Waiguan (Luo-Connecting / Confluent to Dai Vessel / major heat-clearing & exterior-releasing point), TE 6 Zhigou (Jing-River / key point for constipation and hypochondriac pain), TE 21 Ermen & TE 17 Yifeng (primary ear points), TE 4 Yangchi (Yuan-Source).

pathway_zh: 起於目外眥（瞳子髎），上抵頭角，下耳後（完骨），折回額部（陽白），至項後（風池）。交會大椎，入缺盆。胸部分支下腋，沿胸脅下行（日月、京門），過髖關節（環跳）。內行支入胸中，貫膈，絡肝，屬膽。下肢支沿大腿外側（風市），下膝外側（陽陵泉），沿脛骨前外側下行，出外踝前，沿足背出第四趾外側端（足竅陰，接足厥陰肝經）。
pathway_en: Originates at the outer canthus of the eye (GB 1 Tongziliao), ascends to the forehead corner, curves behind the ear (GB 12 Wangu), turns back across the forehead (GB 14 Yangbai), and descends to the nape (GB 20 Fengchi). Crosses GV 14 Dazhui, enters the supraclavicular fossa. An internal trunk enters the chest to connect with the Liver and enter the Gallbladder. The external trunk line descends along the axilla, lateral chest/ribs (GB 24 Riyue, GB 25 Jingmen), hip joint (GB 30 Huantiao), lateral thigh (GB 31 Fengshi), lateral knee (GB 34 Yanglingquan), lateral calf, anterior to lateral malleolus (GB 40 Qiuxu), ending at the lateral tip of the 4th toe (GB 44 Zuqiaoyin, connecting with LR 1).
indications_zh: 頭面五官病症：偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、耳鳴、耳聾、面癱、眩暈。
肝膽病症：黃疸、膽囊炎、膽石症、口苦、嘔吐、肋間神經痛、胸脅脹痛。
循行部位病症：頸項強痛、肩井痛、坐骨神經痛、髖關節痛、膝膝痛、外踝扭傷。
indications_en: Head, face & sensory organ disorders: Temporal migraine, red eyes, tinnitus, deafness, Bell's palsy, vertigo.
Liver & Gallbladder disorders: Jaundice, cholecystitis, gallstones, bitter taste in mouth, vomiting, intercostal neuralgia, hypochondriac distension/pain.
Pathway disorders: Stiff neck, shoulder pain, sciatica, hip joint pain, lateral knee pain, ankle sprains.
applications_zh: 主司疏肝利膽，平肝熄風，清熱解毒，通利關節筋脈。
風池（祛風頭痛要穴）、陽陵泉（合穴/八會穴之筋會/筋病第一要穴）、環跳（坐骨神經痛要穴）、懸鐘（八會穴之髓會）、足臨泣（八脈交會穴通帶脈）。
applications_en: Governs soothing Liver and Gallbladder, subduing Liver wind, clearing heat, and benefiting tendons/joints.

Core points: GB 20 Fengchi (essential point for wind & headache), GB 34 Yanglingquan (He-Sea / Hui-Meeting of Tendons / primary point for tendon disorders), GB 30 Huantiao (sciatica), GB 39 Xuanzhong (Hui-Meeting of Marrow), GB 41 Zulinqi (Confluent to Dai Vessel).

pathway_zh: 起於大趾背毫毛部（大敦），沿足背上行（行間、太衝），出內踝前1寸（中封），上小腿內側（在內踝上8寸處交出足太陰脾經之後），沿膝股內側入陰毛中，環繞陰器，至小腹，挾胃，屬肝，絡膽。上貫膈，布脅肋，沿喉嚨後，連目系，出額，交會於頂（百會）。分支從目系下頰，環唇內。另一分支從肝別貫膈，上注肺（接手太陰肺經）。
pathway_en: Originates on the dorsum of the big toe (LR 1 Dadun), ascends across the foot dorsum (LR 2 Xingjian, LR 3 Taichong) to 1 cun anterior to medial malleolus (LR 4 Zhongfeng), ascends the medial calf (crossing behind the Spleen Channel at 8 cun above malleolus), continues up the inner thigh into the pubic hair region, encircles the external genitalia, ascends the abdomen to enter the Liver and connect with the Gallbladder. Ascends through the diaphragm, spreads in the hypochondrium, ascends the throat to connect with the eye system, and crosses the forehead to meet at the vertex (GV 20 Baihui). A branch departs from the eye system around the lips. Another branch ascends from the Liver through the diaphragm into the Lung (connecting with LU 1).
indications_zh: 肝膽與氣鬱病症：胸脅脹痛、黃疸、口苦、怒氣、鬱悶、中風、眩暈、高血壓。
泌尿生殖與婦科病症：疝氣、陰痛、陰癢、睪丸腫痛、月經不調、痛經、崩漏、尿閉。
循行部位病症：足背腫痛、小腿內側痛、膝關節痛。
indications_en: Liver & Qi stagnation disorders: Hypochondriac distension/pain, jaundice, bitter mouth taste, anger, depression, stroke, vertigo, hypertension.
Urogenital & gynecological disorders: Hernia, pudendal pain/pruritus, testicular swelling/pain, dysmenorrhea, irregular menses, dysuria.
Pathway disorders: Dorsal foot swelling/pain, medial calf pain, medial knee pain.
applications_zh: 主司疏肝理氣，平肝潛陽，熄風止痙，清肝明目，調經理血。
太衝（原穴/平肝瀉火第一要穴）、行間（滎穴/瀉肝火要穴）、章門（臟會/脾募穴）、期門（肝募穴）、大敦（井穴/治疝氣疝痛要穴）。
applications_en: Governs soothing Liver Qi, subduing Liver Yang, quenching wind to stop spasms, clearing Liver Fire, and regulating menses.

Core points: LR 3 Taichong (Yuan-Source / primary point for soothing Liver Qi & calming Yang), LR 2 Xingjian (Ying-Spring / clears Liver Fire), LR 13 Zhangmen (Hui-Meeting of Zang / Spleen Front-Mu), LR 14 Qimen (Liver Front-Mu), LR 1 Dadun (Jing-Well / hernia & genital pain).

pathway_zh: 起於小腹內，下出會陰，沿脊柱正中上行（過命門、大椎），至項後風府，入絡腦，上頂（百會），沿前額下鼻柱，至唇繫帶（齦交）。總督全身陽經，為「陽脈之海」。
pathway_en: Originates in the lower abdomen, emerges at the perineum, ascends along the midline of the spine (passing GV 4 Mingmen, GV 14 Dazhui) to GV 16 Fengfu at the nape, enters the brain, ascends to the vertex (GV 20 Baihui), descends along the forehead and nasal bridge, ending at the frenulum of the upper lip (GV 28 Yinjiao). Governs all Yang channels ('Sea of Yang Vessels').
indications_zh: 神志與腦病：昏迷、癲癇、中風、失眠、焦慮、頭痛、頭暈。
脊柱與腰背病症：腰脊強痛、角弓反張、後頭痛。
陽氣虛衰：畏寒肢冷、陽痿、脫肛、遺尿。
indications_en: Mental & Brain disorders: Coma, epilepsy, stroke, insomnia, anxiety, headache, dizziness.
Spinal & Back disorders: Lumbar/spinal stiffness and pain, opisthotonos, occipital headache.
Yang Deficiency disorders: Aversion to cold, cold limbs, impotence, rectal prolapse, enuresis.
applications_zh: 主司督率陽氣，開竅醒腦，通脊強腰，昇陽舉陷。
百會（頭頂安神提升）、命門（補腎陽要穴）、大椎（解熱要穴/諸陽之會）、人中（水溝/急救甦厥第一要穴）。
applications_en: Governs all Yang Qi, opening orifices, restoring consciousness, strengthening spine/lumbar, and raising Yang.
Core points: GV 20 Baihui (raises Yang & calms Shen), GV 4 Mingmen (primary Kidney Yang tonic), GV 14 Dazhui (clears heat / Meeting of Yang), GV 26 Renzhong (primary emergency resuscitation point).

pathway_zh: 起於小腹內胞宮，下出會陰（會陰），沿腹部正中線上行（關元、氣海、中脘），過胸部（膻中），上喉嚨（天突），至下唇（承漿），環繞口唇，分支上抵目眶下。總任全身陰經，為「陰脈之海」，主胞胎與生育機能。
pathway_en: Originates in the uterus/pelvis, emerges at the perineum (CV 1 Huiyin), ascends the midline of the abdomen (CV 4 Guanyuan, CV 6 Qihai, CV 12 Zhongwan) and chest (CV 17 Danzhong), up the throat (CV 22 Tiantu) to the lower lip (CV 24 Chengjiang), encircling the mouth to below the eye. Governs all Yin channels ('Sea of Yin Vessels') and fertility.
indications_zh: 婦科與生殖病症：月經不調、痛經、崩漏、帶下、不孕、產後諸疾。
脾胃與腸胃病症：胃痛、腹脹、腹痛、嘔吐、腹瀉、便秘。
胸肺病症：咳嗽、氣喘、胸悶、胸痛。
indications_en: Gynecological & fertility disorders: Dysmenorrhea, irregular menses, metrorrhagia, leukorrhea, infertility.
GI & Digestive disorders: Gastralgia, abdominal distension/pain, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
Chest & Lung disorders: Cough, asthma, chest tightness/pain.
applications_zh: 主司調養陰血，培補元氣，溫陽固脫，調理生育與腹部臟腑。
關元與氣海（培補元氣、強壯第一要穴）、中脘（腑會/胃募穴）、膻中（氣會/心包募穴）、天突（利咽平喘要穴）。
applications_en: Governs nourishing Yin & Blood, tonifying Original Qi, warming Yang to prevent prostration, regulating fertility and abdominal organs.
Core points: CV 4 Guanyuan & CV 6 Qihai (primary Yuan-Qi tonics), CV 12 Zhongwan (Fu-Hui / Stomach Front-Mu), CV 17 Danzhong (Qi-Hui / Pericardium Front-Mu), CV 22 Tiantu (asthma & sore throat).

element: Yin/Yang / 十二經脈之海・血海
pathway_zh: 起於小腹胞宮內，下出會陰，經氣衝（ST30），平行於足少陰腎經（KI11-KI21），沿腹部夾臍兩側上行，散於胸中。分支上循咽喉，環繞口唇。為「十二經脈之海」與「血海」。
pathway_en: Points of the Chong channel include: SP 4 Gongsun, ST 30 Qichong, KI 11 Henggu through KI 21 Youmen. Ascends parallel to Kidney Channel on abdomen to chest.
indications_zh: 婦科病症：月經不調、痛經、崩漏、閉經、不孕、產後血暈。
腸胃與心胸病症：奔豚氣、胃痛、嘔吐、腹痛、腹脹、胸悶、心悸。
indications_en: Irregular menses, dysmenorrhea, metrorrhagia, amenorrhea, infertility, postpartum dizziness.
Running piglet syndrome, gastralgia, vomiting, abdominal pain/distension, chest tightness, palpitations.
applications_zh: 調節全身十二經脈氣血，為「血海」與「十二經之海」。
調理婦科月經、胎產與生殖機能，平降上逆之氣。
applications_en: Regulates Qi and Blood of all 12 channels ('Sea of Blood' and 'Sea of 12 Meridians').
Regulates menses, pregnancy, fertility, and lowers rebellious Qi.

pathway_zh: 起於季脅下方（章門），斜下繞腰腹一圈（如束腰帶），行於帶脈（GB26）、五樞（GB27）、維道（GB28）穴。總束全身縱行諸經脈。
pathway_en: Points of the Dai channel include: GB 41 Zulinqi, TE 5 Waiguan, GB 26 Daimai, GB 27 Wushu, GB 28 Weidao, LR 13 Zhangmen. Circles waist like a belt.
indications_zh: 帶下與婦科病症：赤白帶下、子宮脫垂、月經不調、痛經、腰痛如折。
下肢與少腹病症：少腹痛、腰膝酸軟、下肢痿痺、疝氣。
indications_en: Red and white leukorrhea, uterine prolapse, irregular menses, dysmenorrhea, severe lumbar pain.
Lower abdominal pain, lumbar/knee soreness, weakness in lower limbs, hernia.
applications_zh: 總束全身縱行經脈，固攝帶下與胎孕。
調理婦科與腰腹機能。
applications_en: Binds all vertical meridians, restrains leukorrhea, supports pregnancy.
Regulates gynecological and waist/abdominal functions.

element: Yang / 主肢體運動與司睜眼
pathway_zh: 起於足跟外側（申脈），經仆參、跗陽，沿腿外側上行，經股骨大轉子（居髎）、肩胛（臑俞、肩髃、巨骨）、面頰（地倉、巨髎、承泣），至目內眥（睛明），與陰蹻脈相會，沿頭經風池入腦。
pathway_en: Points of the Yangqiao channel include: BL 62 Shenmai, BL 61 Pucan, BL 59 Fuyang, GB 29 Juliao, LI 16 Jugu, LI 15 Jianyu, SI 10 Naoshu, ST 4 Dicang, ST 3 Juliao, ST 1 Chengqi, BL 1 Jingming, GB 20 Fengchi. Originates at lateral heel, ascends lateral leg, hip, shoulder, cheek to inner canthus and brain.
indications_zh: 神志與睡眠病症：失眠（目張不瞑）、日間癲癇、躁動不安、頭痛、眩暈。
運動與肌肉病症：下肢外側肌肉緊張拘急、內側肌肉鬆弛、足外翻、下肢麻木癱瘓、中風偏癱。
頭面五官病症：面癱、三叉神經痛、目赤腫痛、眼瞼瞤動、口眼歪斜。
背部與關節病症：腰背僵硬痛、肩臂痛、髖關節痛。
indications_en: Insomnia (eyes remaining open), daytime epilepsy, agitation, severe headache, vertigo.
Motor impairment of legs, tightness and spasm along the lateral side of legs with medial side flaccid, eversion of foot, post-stroke hemiplegia.
Bell's palsy, trigeminal neuralgia, red/swollen eyes, eyelid twitching, facial paralysis.
Back stiffness & pain, shoulder pain, hip joint pain.
applications_zh: 司眼瞼開合，調節晝夜睡眠節律（主日間興奮與睜眼）。
控制軀體外側運動機能與肌肉張力。
疏通太陽與陽明經氣，祛風清熱明目。
applications_en: Controls eyelid opening and regulates sleep-wake cycles (daytime alertness).
Controls lateral limb movement and muscle tone.
Unblocks Taiyang and Yangming channel Qi, expels wind, and clears head and eyes.

element: Yin / 主肢體運動與司閉眼
pathway_zh: 起於足跟內側（照海），沿內踝上行，經腿內側、陰部、小腹、胸部、過缺盆，沿喉嚨，上達目內眥（睛明），與陽蹻脈會合入腦。
pathway_en: Points of the Yinqiao (movement) channel include: Zhaohai (KI 6), Jiaoxin (KI 8), Renying (ST 9), Quepen (ST 12), Jingming (BL 1). Originates at the medial heel, ascends the medial malleolus, inner leg, abdomen, chest to throat, ending at inner canthus (BL 1).
indications_zh: 神志與睡眠病症：嗜睡（目瞑怠惰）、夜間癲癇、精神萎靡、失眠、多寐。
下肢與運動病症：下肢內側肌肉緊張拘急、外側鬆弛萎軟、足內翻（足下垂）、下肢痿痺。
少腹與生殖病症：小腹痛、髖關節痛、陰部痛、腰痛、帶下、不孕。
婦產科病症：習慣性流產、難產、崩漏、白帶過多。
indications_en: Hypersomnia, nighttime epilepsy, lethargy, insomnia, somnolence.
Motor impairment of the legs, tightness and spasm along the medial side of the legs with the lateral side flaccid or atrophied, inversion of the foot.
Lower abdominal, hip and genital pain, lower back pain, leukorrhea, infertility.
Habitual miscarriage, difficult labor, vaginal discharge, uterine bleeding.
applications_zh: 影響下肢內側、腹部（多為單側症狀）及眼部。
調節下肢運動與陰陽張弛。
總控全身內側與外側之陰氣。
升提陰液，調節全身陰液代謝（陰精、血液、津液、汗液、淚液及結節病變）。
通利明目，清利頭目。
applications_en: Influences the medial aspect of the legs, abdomen (only unilateral symptoms), and eyes.
Regulates motion of the lower limbs.
Controls Yin on the medial and lateral aspects of the body.
Ascends Yin substances, influences all Yin substances (Yin, blood, fluids, sweat, tears, and nodules).
Benefits the eyes and clears head and vision.

pathway_zh: 起於足外側（金門），經陽交，沿下肢外側、軀體側外、肩部、項後，上至額部（頭維、陽白），折入風池，會於風府與啞門。維絡全身陽經。
pathway_en: Points of the Yangwei channel include: BL 63 Jinmen, GB 35 Yangjiao, GB 21 Jianjing, TE 15 Tianliao, SI 10 Naoshu, ST 8 Touwei, GB 13 Benshen, GB 14 Yangbai, GB 15 Toulinqi, GB 16 Muchuang, GV 16 Fengfu, GV 15 Yamen, GB 17 Zhengying, GB 18 Chengling, GB 19 Naokong, GB 20 Fengchi. Links all Yang channels.
indications_zh: 外感與寒熱病症：寒熱往來、惡寒發熱、無汗或多汗、瘧疾。
頭面與少陽病症：偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、耳鳴耳聾、頸項強痛、面腫。
循行部位病症：腰脊痛、肩背痛、軀體側外肋間神經痛、下肢外側痛。
indications_en: Alternating chills and fever, fever and aversion to cold, anhidrosis/hyperhidrosis, malaria.
Temporal migraine, red eyes, tinnitus, deafness, stiff neck, facial swelling.
Lumbar and spinal pain, shoulder and back pain, intercostal neuralgia along the lateral body, lateral leg pain.
applications_zh: 維絡全身陽經，調節表裡與全身陽氣。
主解表清熱，和解少陽，疏風止痛。
applications_en: Links and connects all Yang meridians, regulating exterior/interior and Yang Qi.
Releases the exterior, clears heat, harmonizes Shaoyang, and expels wind to stop pain.

pathway_zh: 起於小腿內側（築賓），沿腿內側、少腹（沖門、府舍、大橫、腹哀）、胸脅（期門），上行至咽喉，與任脈會合於天突、廉泉。維絡全身陰經。
pathway_en: Points of the Yinwei channel include: KI 9 Zhubin, SP 12 Chongmen, SP 13 Fushe, LR 14 Qimen, SP 15 Daheng, SP 16 Fuai, CV 22 Tiantu, CV 23 Lianquan. Links all Yin channels.
indications_zh: 心神與胸腹病症：心痛、胸悶、心悸、胃痛、反胃嘔吐、情志鬱結、焦慮失眠。
陰虛與內熱病症：內熱發燒、盜汗、腹痛腹瀉、咽喉腫痛哽噎。
indications_en: Cardiac pain, chest tightness, palpitations, gastralgia, nausea/vomiting, emotional depression, anxiety and insomnia.
Internal heat fever, night sweats, abdominal pain/diarrhea, sore throat and sensation of lump in throat.
applications_zh: 維絡全身陰經，調節心神與陰血氣機。
寬胸理氣，和胃降逆，寧心安神。
applications_en: Links all Yin channels, regulating heart, spirit, and Yin Blood.
Expands the chest, harmonizes the Stomach to lower rebellious Qi, and calms the Shen.
